meta.name: hellenist_sea_siege
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

programs.brief: A single gigantic sea leviathan surfaces in the harbor and attacks the waterfront: its head and open maw loom over the quay, tentacles break the water and crush shoreline structures, and a wet, cratered wake connects it to the streets. It is a creature rather than architecture, so use prismarine and dark prismarine with sea-lantern eyes and bone-like accents for its own substance, while using api.theme for any grounded quay debris so the invasion belongs to this city.

A field of distinct smaller sea monsters breaches from the harbor and advances inland along the waterfront, with varied serpentine bodies, fins or tentacles, visible eyes, wet trails, foam, slime and toppled modern street furniture so it reads as an active invasion rather than litter. Use prismarine and dark prismarine for the creatures, and api.theme for city fragments and ground scars.

tokens.terrain: a coastal city with a harbor and waterfront exposed to the sea monsters
tokens.infra: barricade_line across roads into the city; emergency defenses along the waterfront
tokens.invasion: sea monsters attacking the modern city
